_provenance.source: Databento CME quote data (tbbo and bbo-1m) for the crossing lines; CME contract specifications and a Databento instrument-definition snapshot for tick values
_provenance.rule: every crossing value is a measurement or a stated convention, and carries its source and, where measured, its window

feeds.tbbo: Databento schema: every trade, with the best bid and offer in force directly before it (sampled in trade time)
feeds.bbo-1m: Databento schema: the last best bid, best offer and sale at one-minute intervals (sampled in clock time)

conventions.crossing_unit: TICKS per ROUND TRIP. Half is charged on each of the two fills.
conventions.commission_unit: USD per ROUND TRIP per CONTRACT, DECLARED. Half per fill.
conventions.default_line_rule: effective_exec_hours where it was measured for the contract: an effective crossing (what an aggressor paid), trade-weighted, over the hours a strategy usually trades. Everywhere else the one_tick convention. A quoted spread is a floor, so falling back to one would make an unmeasured root look cheaper than a measured one.
conventions.window_caveat: every crossing measurement covers 2025-09..2026-09. A tick is fixed in price terms, so a recent spread applied to an older, lower-priced window is optimistic. Each line carries its window for that reason.
conventions.two_statistics: a QUOTED spread (quoted_*) is a floor; an EFFECTIVE crossing (effective_*) is what an aggressor paid. They are never averaged, and the default never falls back from one to the other.

effective_es_bp.statistic: effective, from the half-spread at trade instants, converted to ticks at a median price

effective_exec_hours.statistic: 2*|price - mid| / tick at the instant of a trade, doubled for a round trip, over execution hours 10-15 ET
effective_exec_hours.roots: 8 micro contracts and their 8 full-size parents

effective_all_session.statistic: the same effective statistic over the whole session
effective_all_session.roots: 8 micro contracts and their 8 full-size parents

quoted_all_session.statistic: time-weighted quoted spread in ticks, whole session (a floor on the cost)

quoted_1m_all_session.statistic: time-weighted quoted spread in ticks on one-minute top-of-book snapshots, whole session (a floor)

quoted_1m_at_trades.statistic: the same quoted spread sampled at trade instants (a floor)

one_tick.statistic: convention, not a measurement: 0.5 tick a side, so one full tick a round trip
